test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some chairs are tables.

Some tables are pens.

All pens are inks.

Conclusions:

(I) Some chairs are pens.

(II) Some tables are inks.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e37f455860d9f1ba5416454db4af9f1e8171ff7922837201a9525271d881b123.png] 

Conclusion:

I) Some chairs are pens. Does not follows (There is no relation between chairs and pens)

II) Some tables are inks. Follows (In the above figure shows there is a relation between tables and pens)

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only conclusion II follows****"**.
